description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of tasks performed by generative AI in journalism as analyzed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” It features two distinct segments: the dominant red segment, labeled “Article generation (83.2%),” which occupies the vast majority of the chart, and a smaller yellow segment labeled “Headline,” whose exact percentage is not displayed but is visibly much smaller, suggesting it accounts for approximately 16.8% of tasks. The chart uses a simple color-coded legend with labels placed outside the ring for clarity, and the central white space contains the title “Task Type” in bold black text. The visual emphasis on “Article generation” underscores its overwhelming prevalence in the studied use cases.
